framePolicy: Every original decoded source frame in order. No interpolation, repeated temporal padding, skipped frames, reversal or synthetic final pose.
staticManagementArt: Existing official sprites and all splash art remain unchanged. Pending forms are graphic previews, never playable definitions.

forms.cleanup: Base conservative green key; no aggressive fringe removal.
forms.scope: Five actions sampled at first/middle/final on light and dark, original coarse sheets and consecutive attack/hit frames. Not manual inspection of every frame.
forms.notes: Native KO ending retained, including particles/smoke after the body disappears. Atlas padding remains separate from the 192x192 viewport.
